page.overview:
Who is Slime Face?

Slime Face is an Agents minifigure introduced in 2008.

Slime Face is clad in a black diver's suit dripping with green slime, wears a transparent Insect Helm, and is equipped with a dark stone grey Oxygenbottle With Tube and black Swim Fins. He has a transparent fluorescent green slime-coated face with a wide grin, a green right eye, and a red left eye.

Slime Face is a genetically-altered henchman of the evil Dr. Inferno. In Mission 7, Slime Face and Break Jaw attempt to recover a sunken treasure chest full of diamonds in the ocean.

Slime Face Slime Face is one of Dr. Inferno's henchmen who has been genetically altered. His face is always covered with slime.
